# Native nonempty EdgeClaw memory consumer
Run probe.py with the existing native-business-loop --baseline/--gateway/--sidecar/--out/--provenance-label arguments, plus --candidate-manifest/--source-manifest/--expected-source-sha. Use exact Node22.22.0/ICU78.2 on PATH.
The fixed TS service resolves real storage paths; its actual public MemoryRepository and FileMemoryStore seed a genuine durable project record. No handwritten file format or fake internal memory provider is substituted.
A real Native Gateway then lists the nonempty record, calls actual memory gate and selection over the loopback configured LLM, submits an actual A7 query whose user text does not contain the unique memory marker, and requires that marker in the primary model system context. Same-home restart must preserve the list; public project wipe removes it; a second restart must list empty and the new A7 model context must omit the marker.
This demonstrates concrete configured retrieval/persistence/wipe consumers, not semantic model quality, all retrieval branches, real-provider acceptance or formal scoring. The helper retains the shared diagnostic lock, isolated home/ports/environment, input/output budgets, immutable binary snapshots and owned shutdown checks. Raw model/wire/store records are retained under the exclusive output directory.
